pages.description: StarRiver Arts 以 VR 應用設計、景觀地景建模與數位策展規劃，連結 Studio、ProjectT 與 Museum 季前展。
pages.text: 跳到主要內容 Skip to content 星河 STARRIVER ARTS 星河 · STARRIVER ARTS StarRiver Arts VR 數位體驗的地景創作者 A landscape creator for VR digital experiences 向下探索 Explore below 01 · STUDIO Studio 作品集與專業能力 Portfolio & Capabilities 精選 VR 應用、景觀地景建模與數位策展作品。 Selected work in VR applications, landscape modeling, and digital curation. 進入 Studio Enter Studio 02 · PROJECTT ProjectT 臺灣地景 VR 體驗 Taiwan Landscape VR 從臺灣道路與地景創作出發，連結 VR 世界、Racing Club 與 Time Attack。 VR worlds, Racing Club, and Time Attack grounded in Taiwanese roads and landscapes. 進入 ProjectT Enter ProjectT 03 · MUSEUM Museum 季前展與數位策展 Preseason & Digital Curation 以兩件網頁展覽作為季前展，預覽未來常設展與策展方向。 Two web exhibitions preview the museum's future permanent program and curatorial direction. 進入 Museum Enter Museum CONNECT · SOCIAL HUB 在其他地方找到 StarRiver Find StarRiver elsewhere 社群平台、VRChat、主要內容與社群入口。 Social platforms, VRChat, featured work, and community links. 開啟 Social Hub Open Social Hub 網站由 StarRiver Arts 主導規劃與製作，並使用 OpenAI GPT 與 Anthropic Claude 協助資訊架構與網頁開發。 Planned and produced by StarRiver Arts, with OpenAI GPT and Anthropic Claude used to assist information architecture and web development.

pages.title: About | StarRiver Museum
pages.description: StarRiver Museum 關於頁，說明美術館如何把 VR、網頁與空間敘事視為展覽媒介。
pages.text: 跳到主要內容 Skip to content StarRiver Arts Museum 季前展 Preseason 關於 About 聯絡 Contact EN 中 About 關於 StarRiver Museum About StarRiver Museum 一項以 VR、網頁與空間敘事為媒介的數位策展計畫。 A digital curation project working across VR, the web, and spatial narrative. Museum 預計在明年展開更完整的計畫。現階段以季前展公開兩件網頁展覽，先建立觀看、研究與策展的基礎。 A fuller museum program is planned for next year. The current preseason presents two web exhibitions that establish an early foundation for viewing, research, and curation. 觀看季前展 View Preseason 目前階段 Current Phase 季前展與策展研究 Preseason exhibitions and curatorial research 現有展品是未來常設展的先行版本，不代表完整美術館已正式開館。 The current works are precursors to a future permanent program, not a claim that the full museum has opened. 關注方向 Current Focus 空間、地景與觀看 Space, Landscape, and Viewing 現階段關注虛擬空間的尺度與光線、地景如何被轉譯，以及觀眾如何在數位展覽中閱讀與移動。 The current focus is on scale and light in virtual space, the translation of landscape, and how visitors read and move through digital exhibitions. © 2026 StarRiver Arts StarRiver Museum · Preseason

pages.title: 季前展 | StarRiver Museum
pages.description: StarRiver Museum 季前展以兩件網頁展覽預覽未來的數位策展與常設展方向。
pages.text: 跳到主要內容 Skip to content StarRiver Arts Museum 季前展 Preseason 關於 About 聯絡 Contact EN 中 Off-season Preview · 2026 季前展 Preseason StarRiver Museum 正式開館前的網頁展覽季。 A season of web exhibitions before the full opening of StarRiver Museum. 現階段以兩件數位作品測試虛擬展場的尺度、光線、標識與觀看方式，作為未來常設展及數位策展方向的先行版本。 Two digital works currently examine scale, light, signage, and modes of viewing in virtual galleries, serving as early forms of the museum's future permanent and digitally curated program. 觀看本季展品 View This Season 本季定位 Season Format 網頁展覽與數位策展預覽 Web exhibitions and a digital curation preview 形式 Format 瀏覽器展覽與互動模組 Browser exhibitions and interactive modules 狀態 Status 季前展開放中 Preseason open 本季展品 This Season 兩件網頁展覽 Two Web Exhibitions 兩件作品從完整系統與個別研究模組切入，構成季前展的第一組展覽內容。 The first preseason pair approaches virtual exhibition design through a complete system and focused study modules. 網頁展覽 01 Web Exhibition 01 VR Gallery Spatial System 以系統卡片與標識文件呈現虛擬美術館中的空間尺度、材質、光線、人因與導視方法。 A system of cards and signage documents presenting scale, material, light, ergonomics, and wayfinding in a virtual museum. 可觀看 Available spatial system 進入展覽 Enter Exhibition 網頁展覽 02 Web Exhibition 02 展場研究模組 Gallery Study Modules 透過空間規劃與光線衰減模組，觀察展牆配置、觀看距離與照明變化如何影響虛擬展場。 Spatial-planning and light-falloff modules examine how wall layout, viewing distance, and illumination shape a virtual gallery. 可觀看 Available interactive study 進入展覽 Enter Exhibition 策展方向 Curatorial Direction 從觀看條件開始 Beginning With the Conditions of Viewing 季前展先聚焦於虛擬展覽如何被觀看、閱讀與行走。更多文稿與常設展內容將在方向確定後加入。 The preseason begins with how virtual exhibitions are viewed, read, and traversed. Writing and permanent-program material will follow as the curatorial direction develops. 展覽提案、策展合作與一般詢問可由聯絡頁提出。 Exhibition proposals, curatorial collaborations, and general enquiries can begin through the contact page. 前往聯絡頁 Open Contact © 2026 StarRiver Arts StarRiver Museum · Preseason

pages.title: 社群規範 Community Guidelines｜VRRCTW｜ProjectT
pages.description: VRRCTW 社群規範：尊重玩家、公平競爭、投稿與排行榜驗證方式，以及管理處理原則。
pages.text: 星河 STARRIVER ARTS ProjectT 世界 Worlds VRRCTW 規範 Guidelines 專欄 Articles Racing Hub 賽事中心 Racing Hub VRC VRRCTW / 社群規範 VRRCTW / Community Guidelines 社群規範 Community Guidelines 我們希望這裡是一個能自在聊天、開車、交流技術，也能認真挑戰成績的地方。競賽難免有碰撞，交流也難免有不同意見；我們不期待每個人都完全一致，但希望每個人都能尊重其他玩家，也不要讓自己的行為妨礙別人參與社群。 We want this to be a place where people can hang out, drive, share knowledge, and seriously challenge their own lap times. Racing naturally involves mistakes and contact, and people will not always agree with each other. We do not expect everyone to get along perfectly, but we do expect everyone to respect other players and avoid interfering with their ability to participate in the community. 01 尊重其他玩家 Respect Other Players 請不要持續騷擾、威脅、惡意羞辱、冒充或針對特定玩家。 Do not repeatedly harass, threaten, maliciously insult, impersonate, or target other players. 意見不同、技術討論、玩笑或一時的情緒並不會自動構成違規；管理上會特別考量行為是否具有持續性、惡意，以及是否實際影響他人。 Disagreements, technical discussions, jokes, and occasional frustration are not automatically violations. When reviewing an incident, we primarily consider whether the behavior was persistent, malicious, or had a meaningful impact on others. 02 不要破壞別人的遊戲與活動 Do Not Disrupt Other Players or Events 正常失誤、碰撞或駕駛技術不足都是遊戲的一部分。 Driving mistakes, crashes, and lack of driving skill are normal parts of the game. 但請不要故意撞擊、堵塞賽道、干擾起跑或計時、持續妨礙活動進行，或利用 Avatar、Client、漏洞及其他方式破壞他人的遊戲體驗。 However, do not intentionally ram other players, block the course, interfere with starts or timing sessions, repeatedly disrupt events, or use Avatars, clients, exploits, or other methods to interfere with other players' experience. 正式活動進行時，請配合當次公布的車輛、起跑、賽道與房間管理規則。 During organized events, please follow any vehicle, starting procedure, course, or instance rules announced for that event. 03 公平競爭 Fair Competition 參加計時、排行榜或正式競賽時，不得使用未經允許的方式改變車輛性能、物理、計時結果或取得其他不公平優勢。 During time attacks, leaderboard runs, or organized competition, players must not use unauthorized methods to alter vehicle performance, physics, timing results, or otherwise gain an unfair competitive advantage. 特殊車輛、改裝或特殊玩法若為當次活動明確允許，則不受此限。 Special vehicles, modifications, or unusual gameplay mechanics are allowed when they are explicitly permitted by the event. Unusual Ava…

pages.description: VRRCTW 是中文圈主要的 VRChat 賽車社群，提供賽車活動、日常車聚、Time Attack 紀錄與駕駛技術交流。
pages.text: 星河 STARRIVER ARTS ProjectT 世界 Worlds VRRCTW 規範 Guidelines 專欄 Articles Racing Hub 賽事中心 Racing Hub VRC ProjectT / VRChat 賽車社群 ProjectT / VRChat racing community VRRCTW 中文圈主要的 VRChat 賽車社群，連結喜歡駕駛的玩家、世界創作者與車輛作者，提供賽車活動、日常車聚、Time Attack 紀錄與駕駛技術交流。 A leading Chinese-language VRChat racing community connecting drivers, world creators and vehicle creators through races, casual meets, Time Attack records and driving discussion. 加入 Discord Join Discord VRChat Group Racing Hub 賽事中心 Racing Hub 想來就來，尊重賽程，也尊重一起開車的人。 Drop in, respect the session, and respect the people driving with you. 比賽與日常車聚目前不需事前報名。玩家可依活動公告進入指定的 VRChat Group Instance；可以自由進出活動房間，但請勿干擾世界運作、擅自進入正在使用的賽道，或插入已開始的正式賽程。 Races and casual meets currently require no advance registration. Join the announced VRChat Group Instance, but do not disrupt the world, enter an active course, or insert yourself into a race already in progress. Join 三個入口，各自負責不同事情 Three entry points, three roles Primary community Discord 主要訊息社群平台，也是目前唯一的 Time Attack 投稿入口。查看公告、交流駕駛技術、討論方向盤等控制輸入，並分享活動與攝影。 The main community and the only current Time Attack submission channel. Find announcements, driving discussion, controller setup and photography. 優先加入 Join first In VRChat VRRCTW.2777 在 VRChat 內接收活動通知、查看群組房間，並直接加入其他賽車手。 Receive event notifications in VRChat, browse group instances and join other racers directly. Open Group Data platform Racing Hub 賽事中心 Racing Hub 查詢世界與賽道、玩家與車輛紀錄、世界連結，以及活動時間與地點，作為挑戰下一筆紀錄的依據。 Browse worlds, tracks, player and vehicle records, world links, and event details as a basis for your next challenge. 查看紀錄 View records Community standard 基本規則 Basic standard 請互相尊重他人，遵守秩序，維持運動家精神。完整的社群規範（尊重玩家、公平競爭、投稿與排行榜驗證方式、管理處理原則）請見下方連結。 Respect others, follow the session order, and maintain good sportsmanship. See the full community guidelines below for details on respecting players, fair competition, submission/leaderboard verification, and how moderation works. 查看完整社群規範 Read the full guidelines Season format 賽季與日常活動 Seasons and regular meets VRRCTW 以半年為一個賽季，每季通常安排五至六輪，每輪包含 Sacc 與 CVS 兩場比賽，合計約十至十二場。活動原則上每月舉辦；實際日期、場地、車輛指定或限制與規則，以當期公告為準。 VRRCTW generally runs a half-year season with five to six rounds. pages.text: 跳到主要內容 Skip to content 星河 STARRIVER ARTS 總覽 Overview ProjectT Worlds VRRCTW Racing 工具組 Toolkit 文章 Articles Taiwan Touge Project ProjectT 臺灣山道計畫 Taiwan Touge Project 自臺灣公路地景出發，連結世界、社群、紀錄與賽事工具的 VRChat 賽車社群計畫。 A VRChat racing community project connecting worlds, community, records, and competition tools from the roads and landscapes of Taiwan. pages.title: Beyond Gravity — StarRiver Arts
pages.description: Beyond Gravity：以 VRChat 空間呈現 Skyhook 軌道運輸與太空站尺度的沉浸式概念作品。
pages.text: 跳到主要內容 Skip to content 工作室 Studio 星河 STARRIVER ARTS EN 中 Formosa Aerospace · 2026.04 · VRChat Beyond Gravity Beyond Gravity Beyond Gravity 以 VRChat 為媒介，呈現天鉤（Skyhook）軌道運輸系統的尺度與運作概念。在 Space Jam 3 兩週的製作限制下，選擇以實體空間行走取代說明文字：訪客站在太空站結構中移動，用身體感受軌道高度與機械比例。 作品的核心問題是：科學概念能否在不依賴圖表和文字的情況下被空間化？天鉤站的設計回答這個問題——每個展示板的位置、高度、視角都服從敘事邏輯，而非裝飾邏輯。 Beyond Gravity uses VRChat to present the concept and scale of a Skyhook orbital transport system. Within the two-week constraint of Space Jam 3, the design choice was to spatialise the science rather than explain it: visitors walk through the station structure, using their body to feel orbital altitude and mechanical proportion. The core question: can scientific concepts be spatially experienced without charts and text? The Skyhook station answers this — every display panel's position, height, and viewing angle follows narrative logic, not decorative logic. 技術細節 Technical Details 平台 Platform VRChat SDK3 · PC + Quest 2 雙平台 · 公開世界，最大 32 人 製作時間 Duration 2 週（VRChat Space Jam 3 限時挑戰）· 單人獨立完成 2 weeks (VRChat Space Jam 3 timed challenge) · Solo 幾何結構 Geometry 模組化金屬結構件，手建 mesh + ProBuilder 混合。Quest 平台控制在 200K 多邊形以內。 Modular metal structural components, hand-built mesh + ProBuilder hybrid. Quest target: under 200K polygons. 光照 Lighting 烘焙 GI + 反射探針。模擬軌道太陽直射光（高對比硬陰影）+ 地球反照補光。 Baked GI + reflection probes. Simulates direct orbital sunlight (high-contrast hard shadows) + Earth albedo fill. 互動機制 Interaction Udon Graph 驅動的說明板系統，觸碰觸發文字切換，無需複雜狀態機。 Udon Graph-driven display panel system — touch-triggered text switching, no complex state machine required. ← 上一件 ← Previous — 下一件 → Next → StarSight Mt. 觀星山 年份 Year 2026 年 4 月 April 2026 媒介 Medium VRChat SDK3 群組 Group Formosa Aerospace 製作週期 Duration 2 週 2 weeks 角色 Role 環境設計 · 互動設計 · 單人 Environment design · Interaction design · Solo 狀態 Status 已發佈 Released 星河 STARRIVER ARTS © 2025 · 保存 · 普及 · 發展 Preservation · Accessibility · Development 網站由 StarRiver Arts 主導規劃與製作，並使用 OpenAI GPT 與 Anthropic Claude 協助資訊架構與網頁開發。 Planned and produced by StarRiver Arts, with OpenAI GPT and Anthropic Claude used to assist information architecture and web development.
